messages.batch.cookie-import.install.body: One-click import needs the "Experience Toolbox" userscript running on pixiv.net. The rest of the page is locked during this guide — click the highlighted "Experience Toolbox" install button below; you can proceed only after installing it. If you already installed the All-in-One bundle (which includes the toolbox), just click "I already installed All-in-One".
messages.batch.cookie-import.install.title: 1. Install the Experience Toolbox
messages.batch.cookie-import.ready.body: Make sure you are logged in to Pixiv in this browser. After you click Done, a Pixiv page opens, fetches the cookie automatically and returns within a few seconds.
messages.batch.cookie-import.ready.title: 2. Start the import
messages.batch.cookie.body: To download login-only works (R-18, follower-only, etc.), paste your Pixiv cookie here. You can skip this if you only need public works.
messages.batch.cookie.title: 1. Paste your Pixiv cookie
messages.batch.gallery.body: Finished works land in the local gallery. Open it here anytime to review and manage them.
messages.batch.gallery.title: 5. Browse the results
messages.batch.mode.body: Switch as needed: import works by link, download an artist's full gallery by user ID, search by keyword, or grab a whole series.
messages.batch.mode.title: 2. Pick a download mode
messages.batch.queue.body: Live status and the queue show up here; failed items can be retried with one click.
messages.batch.queue.title: 4. Track progress
messages.batch.start.body: Once you've added what you want, click here. Keep this page open while downloading — the queue is submitted to the backend continuously — and close it only after everything finishes.
messages.batch.start.title: 3. Start downloading
messages.gallery.download.body: Head back to the download page from here whenever you want new works. After you click "Done" to finish this guide, return to the PixivDownloader app window — it will continue the onboarding there automatically.
messages.gallery.download.title: 5. Download more
messages.gallery.filter.body: Open filters to combine tags, authors, age rating and more to pinpoint exactly what you want.
messages.gallery.filter.title: 2. Filter by criteria
messages.gallery.grid.body: Downloaded works appear here. Click one to view it large, add it to a collection, or manage it further.
messages.gallery.grid.title: 4. Browse and manage
messages.gallery.search.body: Type a title or artist name to quickly find what you've downloaded. Switch the search scope from the dropdown on the left.
messages.gallery.search.title: 1. Search downloaded works
messages.gallery.views.body: Move between All, By Author and By Manga Series views to browse your collection from different angles.
messages.gallery.views.title: 3. Switch views
messages.onboarding.detail.actions.body: The action bar for this work: expand / collapse multi-page images, open the original on Pixiv, the showcase, and delete the local work — with page count and format shown alongside.
messages.onboarding.detail.actions.title: 2. Actions
messages.onboarding.detail.author.body: The artist's info. Click to see their other works stored locally, or open their Pixiv profile.
messages.onboarding.detail.author.title: 4. Author
messages.onboarding.detail.meta.body: Title, description and tags live here. Click a tag to filter works with the same tag in the gallery.
messages.onboarding.detail.meta.title: 3. Description
messages.onboarding.detail.series.body: If the work belongs to a series, browse other episodes here; related works are recommended below.
messages.onboarding.detail.series.title: 5. Series / related
messages.onboarding.detail.viewer.body: The work's images show here. Click any image to enlarge it; multi-page works are tiled page by page.
messages.onboarding.detail.viewer.title: 1. Artwork images
messages.onboarding.done.body: You've gone through the whole flow from download to browsing. Next, try Quick Fetch / Search / Series to batch-download more. Enjoy exploring!
messages.onboarding.done.title: 🎉 Onboarding complete!
messages.onboarding.download.filters.body: Filter works by content rating, AI, tags, type, page count, bookmarks and more — works that don't match are skipped during download. Just have a look; don't change anything this step.
messages.onboarding.download.filters.title: 3. Extra filters
messages.onboarding.download.paste.body: Copy the example artwork link below and paste it into the highlighted box:
messages.onboarding.download.paste.foreign: Other content detected. Please follow the guide — this step only takes the example link above.
messages.onboarding.download.paste.title: 1. Paste the example link
messages.onboarding.download.queue.body: Click the highlighted "Import and add to queue" button to add the example to your download queue.
messages.onboarding.download.queue.title: 2. Add to the queue
messages.onboarding.download.settings.body: Set the per-work interval, concurrency, skip-already-downloaded, auto-bookmark after download, filename template and more here. Just have a look; don't change anything this step.
messages.onboarding.download.settings.title: 4. Download settings
messages.onboarding.download.start.body: Click the highlighted "Start" button. Keep this page open while it downloads.
messages.onboarding.download.start.title: 5. Start downloading
messages.onboarding.gallery.card.body: Click this highlighted card to open the artwork detail page.
messages.onboarding.gallery.card.body-fallback: Your downloaded works appear here. Click any card to open its detail page.
messages.onboarding.gallery.card.title: 🖼 This is the work you just downloaded
messages.onboarding.gallery.filter.body: Open filters to combine sort, rating, AI, format, collections, series and more to pinpoint exactly what you want.
messages.onboarding.gallery.filter.title: 3. Filter
messages.onboarding.gallery.grid.body: Downloaded works show up here. Click any card to open its detail page.
messages.onboarding.gallery.grid.title: 4. Work grid
messages.onboarding.gallery.search.body: Type a title, artist name, tag and more to quickly find what you've downloaded; switch the search scope from the dropdown on the left.
messages.onboarding.gallery.search.title: 2. Search
messages.onboarding.gallery.views.body: Switch between All / By Author / By Manga Series on the left to browse your downloads from different angles; collections and page navigation are below.
messages.onboarding.gallery.views.title: 1. Browse views
messages.onboarding.monitor.body: Downloading, please wait… the status bar and download queue below update in real time; we'll take you to the gallery when it's done.
messages.onboarding.monitor.body.no-result: Downloading, please wait… the status bar and download queue below update in real time; we'll prompt you to view the downloaded result when it's done.
messages.onboarding.monitor.fail.body: The example failed to download. Check your cookie and network / proxy, then retry.
messages.onboarding.monitor.fail.title: Download didn't succeed
messages.onboarding.monitor.success.body: Your first work is saved locally. Click the highlighted "Gallery" link to see your result.
messages.onboarding.monitor.success.no-result.bod: Your first work is saved locally. There is no download result entry available for this user, so the guide is complete.
messages.onboarding.monitor.success.title: 🎉 Download complete!
messages.onboarding.monitor.title: ⏳ Downloading the example
messages.onboarding.network.fail: Can't reach Pixiv — check your proxy / network settings
messages.onboarding.network.fail-hint: Common cause: the proxy is off or the port is wrong. Set proxy.host / proxy.port in the app's Settings / config.yaml, then retry.
messages.onboarding.network.intro: Hi, {name}! Before we start, let's check whether the backend can reach Pixiv (through your configured proxy).
messages.onboarding.network.title: 1. Check connectivity
messages.onboarding.orient.choose.body: For your first time, let's use "Import works by link" as the example. I've switched to that mode for you — click "Next" to start downloading the example.
messages.onboarding.orient.choose.title: 4. Pick a mode
messages.onboarding.orient.cookie.body: Paste your Pixiv cookie here. To download login-only works (R-18, follower-only, etc.) you must save a cookie first; this example is all-ages, so you can skip it for now.
messages.onboarding.orient.cookie.title: 1. Cookie area
messages.onboarding.orient.scripts.body: Here you can install the companion userscripts: one-click cookie import on pixiv.net, grabbing artwork links, batch downloading and more. You won't need them for this example — just good to know.
messages.onboarding.orient.scripts.title: 2. Userscripts area
messages.onboarding.orient.tabs.body: Switch between download modes here: quick-fetch your bookmarks / follows / works, import works by link, download by artist ID, search by keyword, or grab a whole series.
messages.onboarding.orient.tabs.title: 3. Download modes
messages.onboarding.redirect.body: The new-user guide starts on the download page and walks you through your first example download. Go there now?
messages.onboarding.redirect.title: 👋 Welcome to PixivDownloader
messages.onboarding.welcome.intro: Nice to meet you! I'll walk you through downloading your first example work. First, what should I call you?
messages.onboarding.welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to PixivDownloader
